content:
Successful HWPX manipulation requires handling fragmented placeholders, clearing layout caches, and maintaining specific ZIP archive structures.
Placeholders like {{name}} are often split across multiple <hp:run> or <hp:t> tags, requiring text consolidation before replacement. Modified paragraphs must have <hp:lineSegArray> elements removed to prevent rendering artifacts or overlapping text in viewers. The final ZIP package must store the 'mimetype' file as the first entry without compression (method 0) to comply with HWPX specifications.
